offline.title: Add offline account
offline.notice: Offline accounts are for local testing only: they can't join servers that verify accounts and have no official skin. Please support the official game.
offline.name: Player name

remove.title: Remove account {name}?
remove.offline: You can add it again with the same player name at any time.
remove.online: The sign-in credentials saved on this computer are cleared too; you'll need to sign in again to use it.

msDisabled.title: Microsoft sign-in unavailable
msDisabled.no_client_id: This build was made without the Client ID that Microsoft sign-in needs (common for self-built copies). External and offline accounts still work.
msDisabled.pending: Microsoft sign-in is waiting for Mojang's approval and will be enabled in a later version. You can use an external or offline account for now.

microsoft.title: Sign in with Microsoft
microsoft.step1: 1. Open this page in a browser:
microsoft.step2: 2. Enter the code below and sign in with the Microsoft account that owns the game:
microsoft.copyFailed: Couldn't copy, please select the code and copy it manually
microsoft.waiting: Waiting for you to finish signing in… (code expires in {time})
microsoft.expired: The sign-in code expired. Please get a new one.

notApproved.title: Microsoft sign-in is temporarily unavailable
notApproved.reason: Your Microsoft account was verified, but Minecraft services haven't approved this launcher to read game profiles yet (every new launcher must apply to Mojang, and this error appears while the review is pending). Nothing is wrong with your account.
notApproved.meanwhile: Once approved, sign-in will work without an update. Until then you can use an external account or an offline account (local testing only).

authlib.serverHint: The skin site home page or its Yggdrasil API address
